title: Bounded weighted cache design and pricing for repeated XLS worksheet queries

scope.primary: private snapshot-scoped worksheet occurrence index retaining every recognized stored-cell occurrence
scope.secondary: SST locator eviction only after descriptor-backed rebuild proof; decoded SST value cache is a separate follow-up
scope.admission: two observations of one worksheet before candidate collection; publish only after a complete successful scan
scope.budget: proposed SourceBackedLimits::max_query_index_bytes, 2 MiB default, zero disables; resident and in-flight candidate weights are tracked separately
scope.eviction: deterministic weighted LRU; skip pinned entries and skip admission when all candidates are pinned

wire_pricing.weight_formula: worksheet: 24*occurrence_slots + 64; SST locator: 24*segments + 16*entries + 64; candidate peak additionally reserves vector capacity and scan/sort/SST scratch

semantic_rules: Only a full worksheet scan that reaches EOF and passes the trailing freshness/cancellation fence may publish an index
No errors, partial scans, visitor failures, invalid SST values, or cancellation outcomes are cached
Every cache hit still fences the source, replays all equal-coordinate occurrences in source order, reads/parses each selected BIFF frame, validates XF, and resolves formula STRING/SST semantics
visit_cells remains the one-scan stream-order path and preserves duplicate occurrences
Candidate builds track resident and in-flight owner weight and use managed Resource::Memory reservations for retained capacity and transient scratch when an ExecutionContext is present
StreamChainHint remains operation-scoped because it borrows SharedOleFile

evidence.prior_repeated_query_price: 0605: 54016 second query adds 25 reads, 615822 bytes, 19 observations

known_gaps: olefile extraction is a wire census and does not prove litchi-xls admission
no Rust build or production implementation was run
allocator headers, cache lock/LRU overhead, RSS, and latency remain unmeasured
SST locator eviction needs an exact descriptor-backed rebuild differential before changing mandatory catalog retention
decoded SST value retention needs a repeated-string trace and separate budget
